# Guidance for AI Adoption: Foundations
SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - not the real National AI Centre guidance.
# Decide who is accountable for AI
Organisations should assign an accountable owner for each AI system and document the intended AI use case.
# Understand your AI vendors
When buying AI from an AI vendor, organisations should ask the AI vendor how the AI model was trained, how the AI was tested and what the known AI limitations are. Consider requesting AI vendor documentation such as AI model cards.
# Test and monitor AI
Organisations should test AI systems before deployment and monitor AI systems for drift and unexpected AI behaviour.
# Be transparent about AI
Organisations should consider telling people when they are interacting with AI or when AI is used to make decisions about them.
